integrity: All proofs and numerical tests are confined to the stated theorem. Finite computations are supplementary and not infinity certificates.
scientific_limitations: Fixed polynomial, differentiation order and coefficient Dirichlet index. No uniform shrinking-threshold counting law or higher Schatten correction. Leading distribution overlaps established locally Toeplitz methods. Publication priority remains uncertain; no independent validation.
title: Two-scale singular-spectrum law for polynomially weighted Dirichlet dilations
